source_text: Non est acceptio personarum apud Deum. Tribulatio et angustia in omnem animam hominis operantis malum, Iudaei primum et Graeci; gloria autem et honor et pax omni operanti bonum.
pass_a_gloss: There is no accepting of persons with God. Tribulation and distress upon every soul of man working evil, of the Jew first and of the Greek; but glory and honor and peace to everyone working good.
pass_b_english: [[God shows no partiality >> Bible:Romans 2:11]]. [[Tribulation and distress for every human being who does evil, the Jew first and also the Greek >> Bible:Romans 2:9]]; [[glory and honor and peace for everyone who does good >> Bible:Romans 2:10]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
